issue.title: Bed matrix returns beds of a deactivated ward but omits their ward summary

GET /beds/matrix?include_beds=true then omits ward6 from wards/summary but still returns beds35,36,37 with ward_id6/current_stateAvailable. Clients cannot find the returned beds' ward name/counts or verify that ward for work. Other wards are unaffected.

Bed matrix's stated per-ward grid/counts should give a coherent ward context for each returned bed. Frontend will visibly mark missing ward summaries and disable service changes on unverified beds, not invent ward metadata or silently assume usable.
